headline: NYM @ SDP matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYM 3.77 at SDP 3.09, with a projected total of 6.86. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward NYM: NYM moved +0.28 runs while SDP moved -0.71, changing the projected margin by +0.99 runs. The projected total fell -0.44, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +7.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Huascar Brazobán has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Fernando Tatis Jr., Carson Benge, Juan Soto, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Sung-Mun Song, Vidal Bruján because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
